rv.q: But the dissonant music heard between scenes suggests the production is also striving for a darker complexity it rarely achieves.

If it's never an ideal production of The Caretaker , it's always thoroughly professional and sharp and shiny enough to keep your interest up until the play's final, ambiguous scene has reached its conclusion.
Still, upon leaving the theater, an unmoved patron is likely to feel that this Caretaker needs a caretaker.
